title: 10-Day Rainfall Forecast – CAR
subtitle: Forecast rainfall for October 5–14, 2026 (as of October 5, 2026)
source: 10-day forecast via Cordillera weather API (snapshot of 2026-10-05); processed by DA-RFO-CAR AMIA

method.note: 10-day total = sum of the 10 daily values (mm).
method.classes: lower-inclusive (5 mm → 5–15 mm); DA-RFO-CAR daily rainfall categories

texts.title: 10-Day Rainfall Forecast – CAR
texts.subtitle: Forecast rainfall for October 5–14, 2026 (as of October 5, 2026)
texts.notes: 1 mm of rainfall is equivalent to 1 liter of rain falling on 1 m² of land. Over one hectare, this corresponds to 10,000 liters of rainfall.
texts.disclaimer: DA RFO CAR is not liable to any loss or damages arising from utilizing the Farm Weather Outlook and Advisory. The forecast is valid only to the dates and municipality stated.
texts.sources: 10-day forecast via Cordillera weather API (snapshot of 2026-10-05); processed by DA-RFO-CAR AMIA
texts.recommendations:
Agricultural advisory for October 5–14, 2026:
- Rainfall is expected to be moderate across CAR. Continue regular farm operations and monitor the next forecast.
- Coordinate with MAOs and irrigators' associations; follow PAGASA and LGU advisories.
texts.issuing_office: Department of Agriculture – Regional Field Office, Cordillera Administrative Region (AMIA Program)
texts.advice_rice: Good conditions for transplanting and fertilizer application between rain days. Keep 3–5 cm of water in the paddies and monitor for pests.
texts.advice_corn: Suitable for planting and side-dressing. Hill-up to improve drainage and monitor fall armyworm.
texts.advice_hvc: Good for transplanting vegetables. Keep drainage open and watch for fungal diseases after rain.
